# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 release candidate** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and modernized package documentation. It ships compiler XML documentation with packages and refreshes HarfBuzzSharp from the bundled native source. Review the HarfBuzz compatibility changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **HarfBuzz combining-class enum member renamed** — UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now CCC132 to match the corrected upstream name; update source code that references the old member. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available** — The aggregate enum mask was removed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m154 and includes upstream m154 fixes for buffer uploads, failed flushes, and general rendering behavior. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114), [#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))

## API Surface

- **Package documentation modernized** — NuGet packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation, with API remarks maintained alongside the C# source for a more accurate consumer experience. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## Bug Fixes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — SkiaSharp no longer attempts to decode RAW and DNG images. Applications that accept these formats should use a dedicated decoder before creating SkiaSharp images. ([#5190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5190))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp now generates bindings from the native source pinned by Skia and updates to HarfBuzz 14.2.1. It also corrects the combining-class enum name and removes aggregate flag masks that are not independent options.
